meta.scope: Offline diagnostics of archived choices under the same frozen target facts; no new executions.
meta.score_scale: fraction_0_1; adaptation_gain_pp is in percentage points
meta.groups_definition: One package-local (task context, native acceptance target) with 16 resource profiles; identical source tasks in separate tracks retain the frozen package structure.
meta.baseline_comparison: Reuse each selector's archived unconstrained choice for the same target; no new baseline inference.
limitations: Switching versus fixed-selection strata are observational, differ in task composition, and do not estimate a causal benefit of switching. A common optimum is a hindsight fact, not information available to the selector.
Edges and target groups share source tasks and recorded executions. No iid significance tests or causal effects are claimed.
Recorded routing systems retain their actual mixed input and recovery protocols; no controlled identical-input comparison is inferred.

definitions.group: One package-local (task context, native acceptance target) with 16 resource profiles; identical source tasks in separate tracks retain the frozen package structure.
definitions.category: Set intersections use only profiles with nonempty F. The four categories are disjoint and exhaustive.
definitions.H_E: Within each class/model, sum satisfaction or relative-efficiency rewards over feasible profiles, divided by all feasible profiles in that class. Invalid/missing package submissions remain with zero reward. These are pooled conditional H/E, not package-macro Q.
definitions.C: Efficiency sum divided by satisfied profiles, over each system's own satisfied subset; null if empty.
definitions.switch_primary: At least two distinct legal selected service IDs among feasible profiles of a group. No natural time/order is imposed on the 4x4 grid. The denominator includes only valid submitted groups with feasible profiles.
definitions.switch_secondary: At least two distinct legal selected service IDs anywhere among all 16 profiles; denominator is all valid groups, matching prior diagnostics.
definitions.invalid_switch: Invalid submissions have null switch flags, are excluded from switch-rate denominators, and remain zero-reward observations in H/E and all-feasible success rates.
definitions.all_feasible_success: A group is successful only if every feasible profile's selected candidate belongs to F (or O for minimum-cost success). Denominator is every feasible group in the class, including invalid submissions.
definitions.weights: Every feasible profile has unit weight for H/E; every task-target group has unit weight for switch and all-feasible group rates. The 1,180-package macro Q is recomputed separately to verify the frozen results.
definitions.interpretation: Switching versus fixed-selection strata are observational, differ in task composition, and do not estimate a causal benefit of switching. A common optimum is a hindsight fact, not information available to the selector.
definitions.no_feasible_profile: H/E, feasible-profile switching, and all-feasible success are null when no feasible profile exists, not a vacuous success.

categories.definition: No profile has a satisfactory candidate.
Intersection of O over feasible profiles is nonempty.
Intersection of F is nonempty, but intersection of O is empty.
Intersection of F over feasible profiles is empty.

consistency.units: Each source task and acceptance target supplies 12 adjacent budget edges and 12 adjacent deadline edges. Main results include only numerically strict relaxations; equal thresholds are reported separately.
consistency.rate_denominator: Edges on which the recorded choice at the tighter condition satisfies its target and both caps. Rates pool these opportunities, not package-macro Q.
consistency.regression_definition: The looser-condition choice is unsatisfactory although the tighter-condition choice remains a feasible witness.
consistency.higher_cost_definition: Tight efficiency is positive, both choices qualify, and the looser-condition choice has strictly higher recorded cost; descriptive, not labeled a necessary error.
consistency.invalid_handling: An invalid package submission has no qualifying tight endpoint, contributes no conditional opportunity, and is retained in total edge counts; failure categories include invalid explicitly.
consistency.dependence: Edges and target groups share source tasks and recorded executions. No iid significance tests or causal effects are claimed.
consistency.protocol_scope: Recorded routing systems retain their actual mixed input and recovery protocols; no controlled identical-input comparison is inferred.

requirements.scope: Independent diagnostics on frozen recorded facts and choices, no reruns or changed scores. Selection-side quantities use the exact same submitted aliases with constraints ablated, not a newly elicited decision.

cost_spread.population: Feasible scenarios with >=2 feasible candidates and positive minimum cost; repeats across profiles are not independent executions.

conditions_note: For each axis, average over the other four resource levels within each target and then each package. ALL is weighted by benchmark package counts. Four condition means recover the main Q.
